faction lowered: None [ edit ] Description Elrena says, "While Zoth Uluus is no longer here, his spoilage remains to corrupt all life." "The unfathomable wall of sea that bore Zoth Uluus at its crest broke here upon the treetops. His darkness seeped into the forest soil and was soaked up by the verdant growth of the forest, giving it a twisted semblance of life." "These living vines creep and destroy what little left that is good. They must be cut back. Bring me their splintered twigs, and I will know of the right you have done." [ edit ] Objectives Travel northeast and slay any spoilcrawlers to be found. Gather their splintered twigs, and bring them to Elrena Faermil at the Recondite Threshold . Splintered Twig (40) [ edit ] Upon Completion You will be given the following rewards: ? Celestine Ward faction A coin reward of 2s 75c A choice of: Potion of Greater Intelligence Potion of Greater Vitality Potion of Greater Wisdom Retrieved from " http://wiki.silkyvenom.com/index.php/Spoilcralwers_of_Zoth_Uluus " Category : Thestra 26-30 Quests
